To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the presence and the kind of sweet taste flavour carriers have significant impact on thyroid hormone axis activity.
the sweet taste flavour carrier, sucralose, has an impact on the thyroid activity and this might contribute to the development of metabolic diseases.
both the presence of a sweetener and the type of a sweetener affect thyroid axis activity in rats, with sucralose being more active than sucrose in this regard.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the potential impact of non-sweet flavour carrier on thyroid activity and may be of importance for the development of dietary guidelines for individuals with thyroid dysfunction or metabolic syndrome.
the potential health effects of non-nutritive artificial sweeteners and the need for their careful use in food and dietetic supplements.
the importance of sweet taste perception in the regulation of the thyroid axis activity.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
sweet taste and the type of its carrier have an impact on thyroid hormone metabolism and thus on the metabolism of the entire organism.
the sweetener sucralose, in contrast to sucrose, has an adverse impact on the thyroid axis activity and might be considered as a factor contributing to the development of metabolic disorders.
the type of sweetener should be considered when evaluating metabolic outcomes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the type of sweetener affects the metabolic outcomes of the diet.
the sweet taste is not only a flavour but also a signal that influences the thyroid axis activity.
sucralose is not a safe alternative to natural sweeteners.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the sweetener’s chemical composition and the way it interacts with the body are crucial for metabolic health.
the type of sweetener should be considered as a factor influencing the thyroid activity and thus the risk of metabolic disorders.
sweet taste is a key regulator of thyroid axis activity and that sweet taste flavour carriers might have a profound effect on the thyroid axis activity.
